limitations.note: The rewrite fixes the counter wrap but also changes when `ready_a` goes high after reset and suppresses `valid_b` during stalls at count 5, whereas the reference preserves both behaviors.

The test exercises stalls after five bits but expects `valid_b` to stay low, and its checker hard-codes `ready_a` high even during reset, so passing confirms the rewrite’s assumptions rather than the reference behavior.
